# UNC School of Medicine

> > The UNC School of Medicine is a leading academic medical center in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, advancing healthcare through clinical excellence, research, and education across multiple specialties including radiology, psychiatry, and pediatrics.

Part of UNC Health Care System, the School of Medicine serves North Carolina and beyond with innovative programs in interventional radiology, telepsychiatry, pediatric specialties, and medical education. The institution is led by distinguished faculty and executives who drive transformation in healthcare delivery and medical research.

## Key Topics

- UNC Health Care System
- Chapel Hill
- Interventional Radiology
- Telepsychiatry
- Pediatric Care
- Medical Education
- Healthcare Administration

- Cystic Fibrosis Treatment
- Telehealth Services
